scripts.dev: npm run mediapipe:copy && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @eidos/server" "npm run dev --workspace @eidos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @eidos/shared && npm run mediapipe:copy && npm run build --workspace @eidos/web && npm run build --workspace @eidos/server
scripts.kiosk: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @eidos/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @eidos/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @eidos/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @eidos/server
scripts.verify:mock: npm run build && EIDOS_MOCK=true npm run start --workspace @eidos/server
